N_D: <int> Number of defending robots on the playing field.
N_A: <int> Number of attacking robots on the playing field.
epsilon: <float> Weight on the defenders' cumulative control effort in the objective.
M_u: <int> Number of sides of the regular polygon approximating each defender's unit-circle control input constraint.
M_I: <int> Number of sides of the regular polygon approximating each defender's intercept region.
M_dz: <int> Number of sides of the regular polygon approximating the circular Defense Zone.
N_u: <int> Number of discrete control steps for each defender.
N_a: <int> Number of discrete sample steps for each attacker.
R_dz: <float> Radius of the circular Defense Zone centered at the origin.
R_I: <float> Inscribed radius of the regular polygon defining each defender's intercept region.
v_a: <float> Constant speed magnitude of each attacker.
T_a: <float> Uniform time interval between consecutive attacker sample steps.
T_u: <float> Uniform time interval between consecutive defender control steps.

defenders.x_s: <float> Initial x-coordinate of the defender's position.
defenders.y_s: <float> Initial y-coordinate of the defender's position.
defenders.xdot_s: <float> Initial x-component of the defender's velocity.
defenders.ydot_s: <float> Initial y-component of the defender's velocity.

attackers.p_s: <float> Initial x-coordinate of the attacker's position.
attackers.q_s: <float> Initial y-coordinate of the attacker's position.
attackers.v_p: <float> Constant x-component of the attacker's velocity toward the Defense Zone.
attackers.v_q: <float> Constant y-component of the attacker's velocity toward the Defense Zone.
